sentences.text:
Bench: K. Lakshman
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Lakshman
 Writ Petition No.1161 of 2025
Order:

Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 4 and Sri Krishna Reddy Putta, learned Standing counsel appearing for respondent No.3.
Perused the record.

2. In view of the nature of relief sought by the petitioners, this Writ Petition is disposed of at the admission stage dispensing with notice to respondent Nos.5 to 11.
3.
Petitioners herein are residents of Ranjole, Zaheerabad, Sangareddy District, within Zaheerabad Municipality.
According to them, respondent Nos.5 to 11 are trying to make construction in Sy.No.111 Part of Gramkantam of Ranjole village by encroaching into the public road by creating documents.

Therefore, they have KL,J W.P.No.1161 of 2025 submitted representations, dated 12.01.2024, 13.02.2024 and 04.11.2024 to respondent Nos.2 to 4 respectively with a request to take action against respondent Nos.5 to 11.
Despite receiving and acknowledging the said representations, respondent Nos.2 to 4 did not act upon the same.
Aggrieved by the said inaction of respondent Nos.2 to 4, petitioners filed the present writ petition.

4. Perusal of the record also would reveal that two Crime were registered against the un-official respondents i.e., Crime Nos.129 of 2023 and 136 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 468, 471 and 420 of IPC.

In support of the said contention, petitioners have filed pattedar pass books and title deeds, RTI information copy of house numbers in Municipal Records, Revision Register, copies of FIRs and copies of registered sale deeds, etc.
According to the petitioners, they have submitted all the said documents to respondent Nos.2 to KL,J 4 along with the said representation, dated 13.02.2024.
Therefore, respondent Nos.2 to 4 have to consider the same.

5. Both learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.3, on instructions, would submit that respondent Nos.2 to 4 will visit the subject property and if the allegations made by the petitioners are found to be true they will take action against respondent Nos.5 to 11, strictly in accordance with the procedure laid down under the Telangana Municipalities Act, 2019 by putting the petitioners and respondent Nos.5 to 11 on notice and affording them an opportunity of hearing.
6.

In the light of the said discussion, this writ petition is disposed of directing respondent Nos.2 to 4 to consider the aforesaid representation, dated 13.02.2024 submitted by the petitioners, inspect the J.
